title: The BGM info: res/sound/interactive/bgm_info.json
description: ARCID_BGM_INFO (a/0/8/6), which BGMInfo_LoadArcData reads (bgm_info.c): the interactive sound subsystem that each BGM uses, which BGMInfo_GetISSSubsystem gives the interactive sound system (iss_sys.c) for the BGM that plays. tools/data/bgm_info_data.py packs it.

bgms.description: The BGMs, searched in order; one that isn't here uses no subsystem. The count is a byte

subsystem.description: The subsystem, of the ISS_SUBSYSTEM_* enum (include/system/iss_sys.h): the road's, the towns' (cities.json), 3D sound (3d_sound.json), the dungeons' (dungeons.json), the BGM switches' (switches.json) or the zones' (zones.json); 1 and 6 have none
